name: anaglyph-look
description: A dark theme with a 3D scene behind the chat for red-cyan glasses: a grid floor rolling toward you, stars, a ringed planet and wireframe shapes floating in and out of the screen.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How far the scene reaches behind and in front of the screen. 1 is the default; lower it if lines stay doubled, raise it if the scene looks flat.

glasses.title: Glasses
glasses.description: How much of the wrong color your lenses let through. clean for glass or good acrylic lenses, typical for most plastic pairs, leaky for cardboard ones that show a faint double image.
